snippet.title: Mari0: AE NEW Mappack (Update 13 Download!)
snippet.description:
Download: https://forum.stabyourself.net/viewtopic.php?f=13&t=3636
Mari0: Alesan99's Entities Update 13 is out!
The default mappack has been updated with new levels.

The mod is available on windows, android, osx, and linux. V13 adds a whole bunch of new items, including ones from Super Mario Maker 2. #mari0 #nes
